baseline.old_public_scope: adaptively observed development; not a current-release official score

before_measurement: Freeze exact normalized inputs, source/scorer/model/training-artifact hashes, candidate configuration and plan before dispatch.
Predeclare training, development, calibration and confirmation roles and duplicate/group exclusion. Runtime gets only state/questions.
Freeze all failed alternatives and disclose previous exposure. No benchmark-ID, expected-answer or input-hash lookup in inference.
Freeze objective and promotion direction before evaluating. Calibration fitting uses only training/calibration, never confirmation labels.
Count actual native requests, smoke calls, retries and failed runs. Budget/deadline/idempotence gates must precede launch.

promotion.development: Predeclared objective improvement and constraints met on exact paired development set; report every gained/lost case and errors. This remains development selection.
promotion.calibration: Independent proper-score replay; use Brier/log-loss against exact observed labels as empirical diagnostics unless actual gold distributions exist. Never call label-only diagnostics official Calibration.
promotion.confirmation: Candidate/artifact/config chosen and frozen before first access to an unused confirmation set; no prior loop use or train/dev/calibration duplicate group/input. One final selected policy evaluated head-to-head; disclose paired uncertainty. Any reused outcomes become development.
promotion.synthetic: Synthetic counterfactual probes test software semantics only and never establish canonical or sealed benchmark generalization.
promotion.official: Publisher primary-source measured full draw, exact selected candidate identity, official score and rank plus score-version eligibility. A queued receipt or our public/synthetic diagnostic never meets official goal.
